armNotes.base: shipping generateBestWeekPlan best-of-5, reconstructed from the same attempt stream; XCHECKed 640/640 vs W1-2
armNotes.oracle: post-hoc per-day argmax across the k attempts, IGNORES the weekly repeat cap — an UPPER BOUND, not a policy
armNotes.master: exact cap-feasible master over the same candidate set (one candidate per calendar day, usage(r) <= repeatCap)
armNotes.greedy: naive greedy-with-skip — MEASURED FOR REFERENCE ONLY; W2-2 §3(iv) forbids shipping it
armNotes.lns: W2-2's recommendation: keep the best whole week, destroy the d worst days, re-solve against the surviving usageCount ledger
armNotes.realised: W2-2's safe rule: cherry-pick argmax; if it passes the cap ship it (attains the bound); if not, LNS repair
